text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! Stuffed, totally stuffed~.
Hey, what should we do after th—...

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text: Hm? Vodka, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Now then, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
? Journey-senpai?
Wonder what's up... maybe I'll go say hi.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text: No no no! Don't, she's terrifying...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
? Terrifying?
What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
What do I mean? It's Journey-senpai!
...I saw her the other day, handling some 'little pests.'

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
?
Well, if there are bugs around, of course you'd swat 'em.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Not like that! There's definitely a dark side behind that smile!
If you watch closely, you'll see—oh, someone's coming!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Halt! Do you have a moment?!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My, if it isn't Meno-san.
Good day. Are you on your disciplinary committee patrol?

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Affirmative! I am conducting an intensive patrol of areas emitting dangerous scents!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that proud nose of yours picked something up.
Behind the school building is rather dim and secluded, after all.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Precisely! ...Therefore, I must ask you a few questions!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation!
Now, this officer shall take her leave—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Please wait.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
There is one thing I would like to ask...
Just what kind of things does that nose of yours react to?

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: What kind of things... you say?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I feel terrible causing you trouble like this...
So I thought it best to properly grasp the details.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: When that exceptional nose of yours...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: When.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Where.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on... Wh-Why are you backing me against the wall?!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...and under what circumstances it activates. Right?

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: ............Why, whenever it catches the scent of danger, naturally!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: I still have patrols remaining, so I shall excuse myself for today! Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: My, my... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
...S-See!?
She looks gentle at first glance, but she was totally threatening her, wasn't she?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? ...Nah, seemed pretty polite to me.
She said she didn't wanna trouble her, just being considerate.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Jeez! You're so simple-minded!
—Urrrgh. Fine, if that's how it is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking through the academy grounds, I spotted Dream Journey and the others.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Lend me a hand, you say?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Senpai, you're in a bit of a pinch, right?
If you don't mind us helping out, we're down!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, this is a purely personal matter.
I doubt there will be any benefit in it for you...

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Come now~, we're all fellow students helping each other out!
...Well then, we'll be waiting for the details!
